Treatment summary: The patient presented with neck strain following a low-speed

course of care the patient attended 33 visits, a volume well above what is usually

Additional body regions were added several weeks after the collision. Imaging and
standard examination tests were within normal limits, and nearly all documented
findings rest on the patient's own pain reports. The history includes a small strain in
the same area years earlier, which healed fully. Billing records show no repeated
charges for the same service. Ongoing care decisions should be reviewed against these
findings.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
